name: com.fujisheng.urui
description: Text-based RML/RCSS UI for AI-assisted Unity development, powered by RmlUi with a managed C# API.

samples.description: Recommended starting sample: North / 07. Loading, mock sign-in, game HUD, inventory, settings and rankings with independent RML/RCSS and bundled resources.
Learning example. Managed Document, query, style updates and disposable click subscriptions.
Learning example. Explicit element creation, scoped queries, hierarchy, classes and click subscriptions; no data binding.
Learning example. Typed controls, form input, focus navigation and a reusable virtual list.
